content:textarea:2:74.name: Paragraph
content:textarea:2:74.html: The Salvation Army needs several employees for short-term seasonal employment as part of our Christmas assistance team. Our Angel Tree program will run from Oct. 6 to Dec. 22 and will require several full-time employees to fill these temporary roles. Salaries range from $15-$17 per hour. Last year we provided Christmas assistance to over 3,500 children and 1,300 seniors in the Charlotte community. If you have a passion for serving others and enjoy the hustle and bustle of Christmas, please apply below for consideration. Interviews will be conducted the week of September 14th and 21st. NOTE: these roles are full-time with daily hours from 8:30 – 4:30 and some Saturday and evening work required.
